en.title: Anthropic IPO filing reveals nearly $900 billion in hidden debt
en.summary: Anthropic has filed IPO prospectus documents, and Bloomberg reports the company plans to take on nearly $900 billion in debt to fund servers, buildings and power. Its balance sheet shows $117.5 billion in liabilities against $112 billion in cash, while lease obligations and off-balance-sheet commitments such as data center, power and GPU purchase agreements are not directly reflected. Anthropic plans to cover these liabilities by growing revenue and raising capital.

en.title: Amp responds to the idea that anyone can push to main: the @AmpCode team doesn't rely on mandatory PRs to block junk code in the AI era. Instead, it relies on small teams, skin in the game, public feedback, and shared taste. Major architecture changes can be finalized in a single Slack thread and one customer visit; as adapters get cheaper, customers use agents to fill in the last 20% themselves. Don't use hiring to avoid prioritization, don't fetishize unit tests—use videos and screenshots as evidence. Tokens aren't a cheat code; they're new infrastructure.

items_all_raw.summary: Figma 宣布 Figma Weave，一个面向持续产出需求的创意团队平台，并把 Weave 创作工作流与 Figma 画框连接起来。Weave 用连接的节点承载图像和视频的生成与编辑，支持分支探索、多模型对比、色彩校正、合成、裁剪、Painter 等编辑节点；工作流可打包成 Weave tool 让团队成员一键运行，社区工具发布已上线。
